harnessSettings.title: Guardrails
harnessSettings.sub: agnts-guard checks Claude's work inside every run, while it happens; agnts's checks after the run still apply.
harnessSettings.profileHelp_minimal: Blocks secrets and dotenv files, enforces team rules with a pattern, and asks for a green build before Claude finishes.
harnessSettings.profileHelp_standard: Minimal, plus: blocks skipped tests, silenced linters, deleted tests and check config changes; lint in the stop gate; quick checks of each edited file.
harnessSettings.profileHelp_strict: Standard, plus: tests in the stop gate, blocks swallowed errors and removed assertions, and the fact check before first edits.
harnessSettings.factCheckHelp: Share of strict-profile tickets whose runs must say who uses a file before editing it, and how to undo destructive commands. Compare the groups on Analytics.
harnessSettings.stallsHelp: The same command failing again and again, no edits for many tool calls, or one file read over and over.
harnessSettings.proveFixesHelp: A bug fix needs a test that fails before the change and passes after it; agnts runs it both ways and shows the result.
harnessSettings.deepReviewHelp: Specialist passes in the code review (security, silent failures, tests, types). Auto: large or complex work only; it costs more tokens.
harnessSettings.learnFromRunsHelp: After a run with failed checks or a stall, agnts may suggest a tip for the repository. Tips stay watched until seen again.
harnessSettings.secondOpinionHelp: Another model reads the chosen approach of complex tickets and says whether it agrees. Empty turns it off.
harnessSettings.advancedHelp: Turn single hooks off; the profile still decides the rest.
harnessSettings.hook_pre_redflags: refuse skipped tests, silenced linters, weakened checks
harnessSettings.hook_pre_rules: enforce team rules with a pattern
harnessSettings.hook_pre_fact_check: ask for facts before the first edit of a file
harnessSettings.hook_pre_destructive: ask for a rollback plan before destructive commands
harnessSettings.hook_stop_gate: build and lint must pass before Claude finishes
harnessSettings.hook_session_progress: give the plan back after the context is compacted
harnessSettings.codexHelp: A Codex model name runs coding on Codex CLI instead of Claude; empty uses Claude. Needs the OpenAI integration and api.openai.com in the allowed hosts (Settings → Preview).
harnessSettings.qualitySub: What agnts-guard and the harness checks did for the tickets of each prompt version.
harnessSettings.colBlocksHint: Actions agnts-guard refused in coding runs
harnessSettings.colStopSavesHint: Tickets whose stop gate sent failing checks back, after which agnts's checks passed first time
harnessSettings.colProvenHint: Bug fixes whose test failed before the change and passed after it, of those with a proof
harnessSettings.colAdoptedHint: Review findings people put into their feedback
harnessSettings.colTokensHint: Average tokens of a done ticket, all stages
harnessSettings.colFactCheckHint: First-try rate of tickets in the fact check group, next to the rate of all done tickets
